Author: Gautam Chowdhary
Bench: Gautam Chowdhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 57431 of 2022
Applicant :- Nazim

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Rabindra Bahadur Singh,Narendra Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-Nazim in Case Crime No.452 of 2022,
under Sections 328, 376(3) I.P.C. Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, and Section 75, 77, 81 of Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, Police Station Civil Lines, District Moradabad, with prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in present case.

He further submits that according to the prosecution story, three named accused persons have been nominated including the applicant with the allegations that one girl aged about 14 years was produced before the Child Welfare Society, Moradabad on 05.04.2022,
whose counselling was done by Tanisha Diwaker, who had stated that her parents are very poor due to which, she was married with accused Irfan, who in turn sold her to Aslam at Delhi.
The victim ran way to Moradabad and met the applicant, who administered some intoxicant substance due to which she became unconscious and rape was committed by the applicant.

Learned counsel argued Nazim vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194527090/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that the applicant a Tempo Driver and when the victim returned, she met with him at Bus stand,
where she asked for money from the applicant to Nepal and during the conversation, the police came and arrested the applicant.
Learned counsel next argued that as per medical report there is no injury either on the internal or external part of the body of the victim as well as on her private part.
It is thus contended that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case therefore, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

It was further argued that the applicant is languishing in jail since 11.06.2022 having no criminal history and that in case, applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in the trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application.

Perusal of the record shows that the victim in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has made specific allegation against the applicant, thus keeping in view submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of offence, nature of allegations, and all the attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, no case for bail has been made out.
Accordingly, the bail application of applicant-Nazim, is rejected.
Order Date :- 20.1.2023 S.Ali  Nazim vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194527090/
